title: Affine diagonal ideal quotient class map
statement: Let f:X → S be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], U and V affine opens with U ⊆ f⁻¹V. Set A=Γ(X,U), R=Γ(S,V) using f, B=A⊗[R]A, W=p₁⁻¹U∩p₂⁻¹U and J=ker μ. For every ring equivalence r:B≃Γ(X×_S X,W) with those two projection formulas, there is an A-linear equivalence e:Ω[A/R]≃Γ(U,diagonalConormal f). For every j∈J, every actual kernel section s whose inclusion is r(j), and every inclusion h:U⊆Δ⁻¹W, e([j]) is the restriction along h of the tensor-pullback adjunction unit on s. The conormal and unit are [def-sc-diagonal-conormal] and [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction].

proof.text: The diagonal pulls W back to U, by preimage_inf, diagonal_fst and diagonal_snd. Form the self-fibre product of g=f.resLE V U hUV and map it to X×_S X. Mathlib Scheme.pullback_map_isOpenImmersion and Scheme.Pullback.range_map identify its range with W. The source is affine since U and V are affine, so W is affine.

Compose the diagonal section map with the two projection section maps using Scheme.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE; diagonal_fst and diagonal_snd give the identity on Γ(X,U). Tensor induction, the two supplied coordinate equations, and a tensor b=(a tensor 1)(1 tensor b) show that the composed map along r is multiplication. Its value on a tensor 1 is a, proving surjectivity.

Apply affineOpen_kernel_conormal_sections to the diagonal, the affine open W, U, r and J=ker multiplication. The preimage, kernel and surjectivity requirements have been proved above. This gives a B-linear equivalence J.Cotangent to the original diagonalConormal sections with the unit formula.

KaehlerDifferential is definitionally J.Cotangent. Keep the additive equivalence and prove A-linearity by replacing a acting on the quotient with algebraMap A B a acting. B-linearity of the equivalence then gives the scalar action through multiplication, which sends a tensor 1 to a. The unit formula is the preceding one; all inclusion proofs hδ agree by proof irrelevance.

theorem diagonalConormal_affine_ideal_class_q (f : X ⟶ S)
    (U : X.affineOpens) (V : S.affineOpens) (hUV : U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1)
    : letI : Algebra Γ(S, V.1) Γ(X, U.1) :=
        (f.appLE V.1 U.1 hUV).hom.toAlgebra
      let W := (pullback.fst f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ⊓ (pullback.snd f f) ⁻¹ᵁ U.1
      ∀ (r : (Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(S, V.1)] Γ(X, U.1)) ≃+* Γ(pullback f f, W)),
        (∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), r ((1 : Γ(X, U.1)) ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, V.1)] a) =
          (pullback.snd f f).appLE U.1 W inf_le_right a) →
        (∀ a : Γ(X, U.1), r (a ⊗ₜ[Γ(S, V.1)] (1 : Γ(X, U.1))) =
          (pullback.fst f f).appLE U.1 W inf_le_left a) →
        ∃ e : KaehlerDifferential Γ(S, V.1) Γ(X, U.1) ≃ₗ[Γ(X, U.1)]
            Γ(diagonalConormal f, U.1),
          ∀ (hδ : U.1 ≤ (pullback.diagonal f) ⁻¹ᵁ W)
            (j : KaehlerDifferential.ideal Γ(S, V.1) Γ(X, U.1))
            (s : Γ(kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
              (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom), W)),
            (kernel.ι (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
              (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom)).val.app (op W) s = r j →
            e (KaehlerDifferential.fromIdeal Γ(S, V.1) Γ(X, U.1) j) =
              (diagonalConormal f).presheaf.map (homOfLE hδ).op
                (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
                  (pullback.diagonal f))).unit.app
                    (kernel (SheafOfModules.unitToPushforwardObjUnit
                      (pullback.diagonal f).toRingCatSheafHom))).val.app (op W) s)
